must_mention_risks.text: Lambda max/reserved concurrency for an SQS event source has no direct Pub/Sub equivalent; concurrency is controlled differently (Cloud Run max instances and concurrency, Pub/Sub flow control)
SQS visibility timeout and redrive policy to dead-letter queues map to Pub/Sub ack deadlines and dead-letter topics, with different semantics
Lambda event-source mapping from SQS must be re-created as a Pub/Sub subscription (push or pull) to the new service
The CloudWatch dashboard must be rebuilt in Cloud Monitoring
